newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta appoints new finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Malta appoints new finance minister.

text.p: Maltese Prime Minister Alfred Sant on Wednesday appointed Trade Minister Leo Brincat as finance minister following the sudden resignation of Finance Minister Lino Spiteri.
Industry Minister John Attard Montalto is to become Minister for the Economy and Industry. Spiteri had previously also been responsible for economic development.

Sant told a news conference that Spiteri's resignation was for personal reasons and had nothing to do with the government's policies. Spiteri will remain an MP and remain active in the ruling Labour Party.
Brincat, an accountant by profession and had served as junior minister for housing and information in the previous Labour government between 1985 and 1987.
In a letter presented in parliament on Wednesday, Spiteri told Sant that when he was appointed in October he had stated he would only serve in the first phase of the government.
He added he felt he could not continue any longer but did not give any further explanation.

Spiteri was one of the most experienced ministers in the five-month old government, having also served as minister in the previous Labour government between 1981 and 1987. He is a former deputy governor of the Central Bank.
